court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Rutuja Pathak vs Dhiraj Balkrishna Pathak
facts_of_case: Parties to the present Application are physically present in the Court and are identified by their respective counsel. Jointly through their counsel, duly signed consent terms are tendered by parties in the present Application which are also countersigned by their respective lawyers.

legal_principles.principle: Parties to a dispute can settle their differences through consent terms.
legal_principles.held: Jointly through their counsel, duly signed consent terms are tendered by parties in the present Application which are also countersigned by their respective lawyers.

legal_principles.principle: Consent terms can be used to settle disputes arising out of matrimonial discord.
legal_principles.held: It is claimed that dispute arising out of matrimonial discord is settled and Consent terms dated 26/04/2022 are drawn to that effect.

outcome.final_order: Present Application stands disposed of in view of terms of consent dated 26/04/2022. Prayer of the respective parties for expediting the issuance of certified copy of consent terms with present order is allowed.
